title: smime-tree: CEK not zeroed after use — cryptographic key material lingers in memory
description: encrypt.rs: cek_buf (Vec<u8> on stack/heap) containing the content-encryption key is never explicitly zeroed before being dropped. The CEK bytes remain readable in memory after encrypt() returns. Trigger: encrypt() is called and the returned ciphertext is inspected by a memory-scanning attacker or process dump tool. Maintenance consequence: any security audit of this crate will flag this; it also sets a bad precedent for future crypto code added by contributors.
